verdict.rationale: Puzzle's API is URL-versioned (/rest/v0, also the server in its published OpenAPI spec). The vendor documents an informal stability commitment: released endpoints will remain stable, and it will work with customers on changes. However, the version is v0, the API is described as under development, and there are no deprecation timelines, changelog, or formal policy page. missing for 10: formal documented deprecation policy with notice periods/timelines, public changelog, stable (non-v0) version line, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: what is currently documented here and released will remain stable for the indefinite future. We will work with you on any potential changes to assure a smooth transition.
